data.gender_notes: Asmi is used as a unisex name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit root ‘as’ meaning ‘self’, ‘I’, ‘mine’. This name signifies a deep sense of self-awareness and individuality. In Hindu mythology, it is also the name of a goddess, Asami, associated with the sun, light, and knowledge. The name Asmi carries the meaning “Self, I, Mine” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Asmi usually hope their child will grow to embody self, i, mine and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Asmi total 6, giving a life-path number of 6. Number 6 is linked with Venus and with the qualities of responsibility, care and community.

data.spiritual_significance: The name "Asmi" has a deep spiritual significance. It conveys a sense of connection to the self, reminding us of our own individuality and worth. The name Asmi also symbolizes the light and knowledge that come from within and the illumination of one's path towards personal growth and enlightenment.
